selection: LTS filesystem implementation plus separately selected Android hooks, namespace exports, OEM storage and dm-default-key integration.
reason: SDK board/fstab/x86 uses ext4. LTS already supplies ext4/fsverity and baseline F2FS interfaces. Omit optional newer fsverity hash-table/readahead rework and F2FS device-alias extension/performance refactors rather than risk overriding stable integrity/lifetime fixes. F2FS hooks remain for Android configuration/module-source compatibility. No conclusion about future platforms or all external consumers.
netfs: Discard residual KMI front-pointer resurrection and preserve LTS acquire list traversal. Namespace import retained.
